profile.headline: Engineering Leader | AI-Driven Modernization | Platform Reliability & Delivery
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, I've led growth in UX teams & commerce platforms and driven innovation through AI-led initiatives and operational improvements. My work focuses on building tools that streamline workflows, enhance team collaboration, and deliver reliable solutions for critical business scenarios.

I bring 16+ years of industry experience, where my focus has been on empowering teams to solve complex problems with both technical expertise and a customer-centric mindset. I thrive in collaborative environments by blending deep problem-solving skills with an understanding of real-world needs—whether it's creating tools that improve engineering processes or building systems and experiences with privacy, security, and accessibility baked in from the very beginning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Purchase Experience
positions.description:
Driving AI Engineering Leadership
 • Proposed and led an AI‑first Enzyme → React Testing Library modernization, building the AI agent that transformed a year of manual work into a background task completed in under 30 minutes per file, freeing engineers from high‑toil migration work and accelerating React 18 readiness
 • Authored more than half of the modernization effort across 467 files and built the team’s Copilot plugin (hooks, agents, skills, MCP configs), improving workflow speed and integration reliability
 • Built privacy‑compliant MCP servers adopted beyond the team and contributed to Microsoft’s in‑house plugin marketplace tooling, enabling automatic dependency installation for end‑users and parallel version pinning for developers without dependency conflicts

Leading Cross‑Team Alignment
• Shipped GDPR‑compliant behavioral analytics using MS Clarity, partnering with stakeholder and engineering teams to implement strict consent gating and content masking
 • Partnered with long‑tenured engineers to codify the team’s coding standards into the AI conversion agent, driving the process end‑to‑end and ensuring the system produced human‑quality output aligned with established team expertise
 • Coordinated partner teams and managed ~100k test accounts as back‑up lead for holiday readiness load testing, driving real‑time incident resolution and delivering a high‑severity‑incident‑free holiday season

Developing People and Engineering Culture
• Supported incoming program owners during holiday readiness efforts, providing clarity, context, and steady guidance so they could assume long‑term ownership with confidence
 • Partnered with engineers throughout complex delivery cycles and modernization initiatives, offering technical direction, removing blockers, and helping them navigate ambiguity
 • Strengthened team performance by fostering an environment where engineers could expand their responsibilities, grow their influence, and operate with greater autonomy

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Team lead, Purchase Experience Data Analytics
positions.description:
Operational transformation & delivery
 • Delivered an accessible anti‑fraud challenge and analytics dashboard for Purchase Experience, improving fraud detection, customer trust, and visibility for partner teams
 • Completed security‑compliance reviews on schedule and shipped a new localized string service with seamless cutover and zero downtime
 • Drove Azure cloud cost reductions far beyond target through architectural improvements and operational rigor
 • Led migration from Azure Data Factory to Microsoft Fabric, establishing a modern analytics foundation that improved scalability, reliability, and readiness for AI‑driven workflows

Team leadership & org alignment
• Led scrum operations and high‑visibility projects that strengthened psychological safety and improved execution discipline
 • Facilitated retrospectives that expanded engineers’ scope of impact and improved cross‑team collaboration
 • Established clearer delivery processes that improved predictability and alignment across engineering, product, and partner teams

People development
• Coached engineers through complex delivery cycles and cross‑team initiatives
 • Strengthened team communication, collaboration, and ownership through structured leadership practices
 • Elevated team performance by creating an environment where engineers could take on broader responsibilities and grow their influence

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Team lead, Commerce CMS Onboarding Engineering
positions.description:
Operational transformation & delivery
 • Authored the white paper that realigned engineering and business onboarding strategy
 • Delivered a new Azure‑hosted .NET onboarding service, reducing tenant onboarding from 6–12 months to a week or less, freeing significant engineering capacity for platform development
 • Shipped localization tooling that reduced troubleshooting time for CMS engineers and partner teams

Team leadership & org alignment
 • Transformed ambiguous direction into a shared, executable plan
 • Raised team‑health metrics for eight engineers to 100%
 • Strengthened cross‑team alignment through collaborative leadership and problem‑solving
 • Established durable processes that improved clarity, execution, and delivery

People development
 • Mentored two engineers through successful promotions
 • Coached a senior engineer into a team‑lead role
 • Built a stronger leadership pipeline and expanded team impact

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead on Fusion Quick Access Bar
 * Led a team of engineers in creating a new GUI, which was received positively by our users
 * Established a strong pattern of using telemetry for data-driven production decision making

Technical lead on Feature Flags
 * Introduced the concept to management
 * Conducted an accessibility study of a candidate platform, yielding required changes
 * Produced a simple, consistent API for native and .NET applications

Model and assist the organization in adopting Agile methodologies
 * Establishing feature crews
 * Defining OKRs
 * Habituate effective daily status meetings to ensure project progress
 * Frequently deliver minimum viable changes while seeking stretch goals

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Passionate accessibility champion on Microsoft’s flagship communication product for Windows: Outlook, thrilling our customers by making experiences easy to use and facilitating what couldn't be done before!

As the team’s accessibility stakeholder, I
- Drove a culture shift from accessibility as a compliance roadblock to a shared passion by
  o Connecting the development team with users with disabilities, gaining empathy and understanding of needs
  o Continuously educating the team about the impact of accessibility 
  o Codifying simple, cost-saving processes for WCAG 2.1 compliance and customer-driven feature development
  o Updating the development environment to have the newest accessibility testing tools
  o Designing and implementing accessibility features
- Improved cross-team collaboration by
  o Kicking off regular conversations between accessibility stakeholders on various teams
  o Negotiating processes ensuring accessibility for cross-team projects
- Connected with users and accessibility advocacy groups in person, presenting and staffing booths at CSUN AT and AFB conferences, presenting webinars, through social media

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented new features in Outlook email attachments: 
   - A new Most-Recently-Used file list which makes it easier to find the files you want to share
   - "Cloudy attachments" which make it easier to collaborate on files already in the cloud
 
Participated in Outlook's successful transition from a 2-3 year waterfall cycle to a much faster set of staggered waterfalls with monthly releases.

Supported in-market versions of Outlook to improve existing scenarios causing user pain.

Promoted to Software Engineer 2 in September 2015.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Created components used by nearly every internal automated calendar test script created by the calendar test team as part of a push driving code coverage up.

Implemented automation scripts using those test components, which were part of my team yielding the greatest increase in the number of lines of code-coverage of any test team in the Outlook 2013 product cycle.

Designed and implemented automation tools for future versions of Outlook that improved automated test script durations, reliability of test scripts, and the value of time spent writing scripts, as greater product code-coverage can more easily be achieved and more complex scenarios can be automated more easily.

Tested the calendar of Outlook 2013 RTM while in development.

Tested the calendar of Outlook when releasing service packs, Outlook 2010 SP1 and SP2, and Outlook 2007 SP2, as well as various hotfixes and public updates on all in-market versions of Outlook.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted students in understanding materials taught in class so they can complete complex projects. Assisted the teacher in grading assignments and proctoring exams.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed software solutions to internet security problems as a member of the Blue Coat Web Filter team.
Created tools for internal metrics.

company.name: Brigham Young University - Office of Information Technology

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed software solution for Brigham Young University's Open Access Computer Labs. Improved user interfaces, run-time delays, and server-client interactions in this proprietary software. Helped lower the univerisity's costs on software licensing by determining how many licenses were really needed for certain applications. This was done through a new feature I helped develop.

positions.title: Support Technician
positions.description: Managed the machines in Brigham Young University's Open Access Computer Labs, which are provided for student use. Performed physical repairs, set up new labs, managed the university WSUS server, and the default image for lab machines.
